title: Gukurikirana mu buryo bw'ubucamanza
intro: Mu nzira z'ubutegetsi, umuntu wo mu rwego rwo hejuru yakunze umugaragu wari ufite ubwiza budasanzwe. Uku gukunda Imana kwatumye habaho ibintu byinshi byageragezaga ubudahemuka, bigahishura ukuri kwihishe, amaherezo bigashimangira ko umugaragu ari umwere.
clues: Nabaye mu gihugu cya Nili, mu ngoro yari ifite ububasha bukomeye.
Umusore yinjiye mu rugo rwanjye, maze kuba ariho byanteye ubwoba.
Nagerageje kumushukashuka, ariko yashakiye ubuhungiro kuri Nyagasani we.
Namutanyuriyeho umwenda we inyuma, ariko ibimenyetso byerekanaga ko ari uburiganya bwanjye.
Kugira ngo ncecekeshe ibihuha by'abagore b'abanyacyubahiro, nabatumiye mu ikoraniro maze mbashyira ibintu bityaye mu ntoki zabo.
Amaherezo, nemeye icyaha cyanjye ku mugaragaro, nemera ukuri imbere y'umwami.
arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
